description: Decision 108 (S4K-1): research.network.ac_losses = linear_proxy (main) | pypsa_tangent (S4J state: PyPSA transmission_losses = 2; default when absent) | none (AC lossless, DC / pipeline losses kept); with research.network.transmission_losses = none the AC lines are lossless as well

Decision 108 (S4K-1), registered deviation from PyPSA-Eur (solving.options.transmission_losses = 2): the candidate lines are extended from one circuit by up to +20 GW, far beyond the usual PyPSA-Eur case, and with the resistance fixed the tangent approximation (tangent points on s_nom_max) is distorted (zero loss below 3.5-13 GW, 16 lines built exactly to the zero-loss limit in the S4J smoke); when the circuits grow with the flow the loading per circuit stays about constant and the loss is about proportional to the flow, as the DC efficiency per length; the iterative impedance update (skip_iterations: false) is not used because it needs several solves per run, not feasible for the coalition study
source: S4K instruction S4K-1 point 6; S4J report 8.6

description: Decision 108 (S4K-1): lambda per AC line by line type, one circuit: R = r_per_length x length (model length incl. the 1.25 length factor), lambda = sqrt(3) x I_ref x R / v_nom (kA, Ohm, kV); all 148 lines are 'Al/St 240/40 4-bundle 380.0' (r 0.03 Ohm/km, i_nom 2.58 kA, 380 kV, s_max_pu 0.7): lambda = 0.77-13.66 % (median 3.50 %); check at 100 km 1.235 % (expected about 1.2 %) and 2.470 % (about 2.5 %), within 20 %

Decision 108 (S4K-1): the line loss is withdrawn half at each end and settled at the nodal price of that end (p0 = s + loss/2, p1 = -s + loss/2); the corridor of a cross-border line pays p0 x price0 + p1 x price1, its rent R = (-p1) price1 - p0 price0 (loss included) is split 50/50 with the infrastructure cost; settlements cancel between entities, so sum(countries) + bunker = objective - pool surplus (gate B16)

Decision 108 (S4K-1): the PyPSA 0.30.3 loss structure is kept - 'Line-loss' >= 0 per line and snapshot (variables.py 146-155), -0.5 x loss in the nodal balance at bus0 and bus1 (constraints.py 556-560), the loss in the line capacity rows (72-75, 117-120), Kirchhoff rows with the flow only (619 ff.), p0 / p1 += loss / 2 after the solve (optimize.py 456-459); the tangents and the r (s_max_pu s_nom_max)^2 upper bound (932-975) are replaced by loss >= lambda s, loss >= -lambda s, loss <= lambda s_max_pu s_nom (variable s_nom for extendable lines); solver transmission_losses = 0; hook research_ac_loss_proxy rebuilds the nodal balance and capacity rows with PyPSA's own functions; model check: rows minus the loss terms equal the lossless model row by row
Decision 108 (S4K-1): alpha = reference current as a share of the allowed loading of one circuit (I_ref = alpha x s_max_pu x i_nom); main 0.5, sensitivity 1.0 (upper bound of the proxy)
